pred_texts: Instruct: First grab a microwave-safe mug or bowl that is at least 6 ounces.
Instruct: Now add 4 tablespoons of flour to the mug.
Instruct: Now add 2 teaspoons of sugar.
Instruct: Now add 2 tablespoons of cocoa powder.
Instruct: Now add a pinch of salt.
Instruct: Now stir and mix the solid ingredients together well.
Instruct: Now add 3 tablespoons of milk to the mixture.
Instruct: Now add 2 teaspoons of oil.
Instruct: Now mix the ingredients in the bowl together.
Instruct: Now add one egg to this mixture.
Instruct: Now stir the mixture together until well blended.
Instruct: Now you add one tablespoon of water.
Instruct: Now you can stir the mixture together vigorously until smooth, for about one minute.
Instruct: Now you can add one teaspoon of peanut butter to the mixture.
Instruct: Now fold the peanut into the mixture by gently stirring.
Instruct: Now microwave the mixture for about one minute.
